notes: MCP 2025-06-18+: tool.outputSchema describes CallToolResult.structuredContent only. Human-readable content blocks are always preserved unchanged.

Bifrost is a passthrough gateway; it does not synthesize schemas. Normalization happens in scripts/bifrost/mcp_output_schema_adapter.py, injected into each stdio launch by scripts/bifrost/render_bifrost_config.py.
Single gateway architecture is unchanged: no new MCP route, no new tool, no second front door.

Every server that is enabled AND reachable through a capability profile must resolve to adapter stdio_envelope or upstream_native, otherwise scripts/bifrost/validate_output_schemas.py reports MissingOutputSchema.
http/sse upstreams cannot be wrapped by a stdio normalizer; they stay adapter=unsupported and must remain out of capability_profiles[*].allowed_server_ids.

tools/list size: defaults.detail=compact emits ~1.5KB of outputSchema per tool (~210KB across the current surface). Switch to detail=minimal (~0.5KB per tool, ~60KB total) if client context cost matters more than per-tool schema detail; structuredContent still validates under either setting.

generic.description: Fallback envelope with an unconstrained data payload.

memory.description: AgentCore durable memory: stable ids, session/project keys, cursors, projections. Never credentials.

project_router.description: Registered worktree activation: project_key, active project, safe root path, boundary policy.

docs.description: Documentation indexing/search: library, version, source url, job/index status, result refs.

code_intel.description: Semantic code navigation: symbol/file refs, match counts, impacted files. No whole-file dumps.

reasoning.description: Structured planning progress only. Hidden chain-of-thought is never surfaced in summary.

dep_graph.description: Dependency graph, blast radius, impact level, risks, verification recommendations.

diagram.description: Architecture/graph artifacts: diagram id/url/path, node and edge counts, render status.

context_fabric.description: Capture/query ids, context pack refs, drift severity, decision ids.

fs_artifact.description: Bounded filesystem artifacts: paths, counts, byte sizes, truncation flags.

browser.description: Bounded browser automation: url, operation, artifact refs, console/network counts, risk flags.

external.description: External/untrusted registries and remote agents: ids, status, urls, trust class.

notes: Upstream already returns structuredContent (legacy payload). The normalizer preserves it verbatim under envelope.data, so direct-stdio acceptance tests are unaffected.
Skills-Hub registry content is raw_untrusted; the envelope never promotes it.

artiforge.reason: http upstream; a stdio normalizer cannot wrap it. Keep enabled=false and out of every capability profile until an http-side contract exists.

depwire-cloud.reason: http upstream; not wrappable by the stdio normalizer. Remains enabled=false.

openrouter.reason: http upstream, status dormant, zero tools without an M6 capability lease. Must not appear in capability_profiles[*].allowed_server_ids.

google-sheets-mcp.reason: remote http upstream in developer_preview_oauth_pending; zero default exposure.
